title: Review-finding idiom in the skill: blockers as required children, deferred findings optional or independent roots; rejection = evidence note + cancel + parent waiver
outcome: Review-finding idiom in the skill: blockers as required children, deferred findings optional or independent roots; rejection = evidence note + cancel + parent waiver
acceptance: the review-changes and engram-repo skills distinguish three placements for a finding on an open item: a required child only when landing depends on it; an optional child only for work intentionally finished inside the parent's execution window; an independent root (with provenance in a note) for a genuinely deferred finding, even while the reviewed item is still open, so it outlives the parent's completion — never a blanket 'nonblocking findings are optional children'

the skills state the rejection idiom: a finding rejected on evidence gets an evidence note, cancel with the reason, and — when it was required — the parent's --waive with that reason; done is reserved for satisfied current acceptance and its receipt makes that assertion visible

completion.summary: Landed review and skill guidance for required, optional-in-window and deferred-independent placement, plus evidence rejection rather than false completion; docs gates and pair review passed.
